summary: 本文提出了 Transformer，一种完全基于注意力机制、摒弃循环和卷积的序列转导模型。它在 WMT 2014 英德和英法翻译任务上取得了当时最优的 BLEU 分数，同时训练并行度更高、耗时显著更少。论文还通过消融实验和英语成分句法分析任务验证了模型的通用性，并分析了自注意力相对于循环和卷积层的优势。

research_question.text: 现有序列转导模型主要依赖循环或卷积网络，其固有的顺序计算特性限制了训练样本内部的并行化，在长序列上尤为严重。本文旨在提出一种完全基于注意力机制、无需循环和卷积的新架构，以突破这一计算瓶颈并提升翻译质量。

evidence.quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism

method.text: Transformer 采用编码器-解码器结构，每部分由 6 层相同的层堆叠而成。核心是缩放点积注意力和多头注意力机制，配合位置前馈网络、残差连接、层归一化以及正弦位置编码。编码器自注意力可关注所有位置，解码器自注意力通过掩码防止左侧信息泄露。

evidence.quote: The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
We call our particular attention "Scaled Dot-Product Attention"
we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
we add "positional encodings" to the input embeddings at the bottoms of the encoder and decoder stacks

experiments.text: 在 WMT 2014 英德（约 450 万句对）和英法（3600 万句对）翻译任务上训练和评估，使用 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU。此外，在 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分（约 4 万句）及半监督设置（约 1700 万句）上进行英语成分句法分析实验。还通过消融实验（表 3）分析了注意力头数、键维度、模型大小、dropout 和位置编码方式的影响。

evidence.quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
we varied our base model in different ways, measuring the change in performance on English-to-German translation on the development set

findings.text: Transformer 在英德翻译上达到 28.4 BLEU，超越此前最佳模型（含集成）超过 2 BLEU；在英法翻译上达到 41.8 BLEU（单模型），训练成本仅为先前最优模型的一小部分。消融实验表明多头注意力优于单头，键维度减小会损害质量，dropout 有助于防止过拟合，正弦与学习式位置编码效果相近。在英语成分句法分析上，Transformer 也优于 BerkeleyParser 等模型。

evidence.quote: establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models
While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences.

limitations.text: 论文指出，自注意力在序列长度小于表示维度时比循环层更快，但对于非常长的序列，计算复杂度可能成为问题，未来可考虑限制注意力到局部邻域。此外，自注意力因对注意力加权位置取平均而降低了有效分辨率，需通过多头注意力来抵消。论文还提到将模型扩展到文本以外的模态（如图像、音频、视频）以及研究局部受限注意力是未来工作。

evidence.quote: To improve computational performance for tasks involving very long sequences, self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$
albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms
